title: Really good habit tracker
body:
I really love the design, it’s simple and very user friendly. It shows you right a way the habits and how you are doing. 
Even though it’s very well looking, I found some design decisions a little bit confusing to the user: like the strike counter, the habit count, the Xs on the calendar or highlighting the entire week for weekly habits. Those were the little things that took me some days to understand/get used to. 
One thing I would love is to see is a Monthly subscription. The Yearly feels a little bit too much.
Nevertheless the app is great!
author: totofrechou
